title: Shifting Letters
summary: Given a string s consisting of lowercase English letters and an integer array shifts of the same length, for each shifts[i] = x, shift the first i + 1 letters of s, x times.
statement: Given a string s consisting of lowercase English letters and an integer array shifts of the same length, for each shifts[i] = x, shift the first i + 1 letters of s, x times. Return the resulting string after applying all shifts.
constraints: shifts[i] rotates letters 0 through i forward with wraparound.
hints: Position i receives every operation whose prefix reaches i, which is the suffix sum from i onward.
Scan both arrays right-to-left with a running shift modulo 26.
The running total contains exactly the operations affecting the current and earlier positions.
editorial: The running total contains exactly the operations affecting the current and earlier positions.

tests.explanation: Suffix shift totals are 17,14,9, producing rpl.
The letters receive totals six, five, and three, producing gfd.
